skills.name: Gourmet Charge（尋味飛撲）
skills.description: Mishige commands Porkie the piglet to crash into a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

skills.name: Ready to Feast (蓄食待發)
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
At the end of a non-summoned ally's turn, and Mishige isn't immobile, she gains 1 stack of Grain Reserve.
;
:
;Upon Usage
:Mishige gains 2 stacks of Grain Reserve and increases the SPD of all other allies by 30. Then she gains a Huge Appetite, lasts for 1 turn.
;Grain Reserve (不動穀)
:
:'''Buff, Mark''': Max 10 stacks. Each stack increases ATK by 10% and Crit DMG by 5%. If Mishige has 6 or less stacks, she is cannot Assist or receive Calls to Arms. Stacks won't reset in multi-round battles.
;Huge Appetite (食欲増進)
:
:'''Buff, Mark''': At the end of a non-summed enemy's turn, can gain 1 stack of Grain Reserve.

skills.name: Appetite Stimulated (胃口大開)
skills.line: Warm smiles spread across the land with the smell of rice!
skills.description:
This skill unlocks when Mishige has 6 or more stacks of Grain Reserve. Upon usage, Mishige launches an attack on the enemy with the highest HP, dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK. Then she inflicts 8 strikes on random enemies, dealing damage equal to 33% of her ATK with each strike.
After the attack, 4 stacks of Grain Reserve are consumed.

upgrades.text: Damage for the first hit increases to 110%.
Damage for the first hit increases to 120%.
Damage for the first hit increases to 130%.
Damage for the first hit increases to 150%.

skills.name: Appetite Stimulated: Voracious (胃口大開・呑食天地)
skills.description:
When Mishige has 10 stacks of Grain Reserve, this skill is automatically used free of onibi. If she is inflicted with a control effect, then 5 stacks of Grain Reserve will be consumed to dispel or remove all of them first.
Upon usage, Mishige launches attack on the enemy with the highest HP dealing damage equal to 180% of her ATK once and deals equally distributed true damage equal to 40% of that damage to all other enemies. Then she inflicts 9 strikes on random enemies, dealing damage equal to 33% of her ATK.
After the attack, all stacks of Grain Reserve are consumed.

upgrades.text: Damage for the first hit increases to 200%.
Damage for the first hit increases to 230%.

bio.condition: Team Mishige with another player's Shokurei and clear any zone 10 times.
